en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The main images show a large Gothic cathedral with twin spires and an attached castle complex on a hill above a town and river, photographed by day and illuminated at night. A bridge crosses the river in the night view. Another panel shows the interior of a traditional restaurant with wooden chairs, tables with white cloths, wall pictures and hanging lamps. In the center there is a title block with stylized German text referring to a historic guesthouse.
